envelope.description: ItemMeasure carries the item's content from its file

body.title: ItemMeasure carries the item's content from its file
body.summary: Add the optional content field to ItemMeasure in src/analyze/item-length.ts and have measureItem return the text it already reads when the recorded file hash matches (whole file for a document, file or config entity, the start-to-end line range for any other). When the file is missing, unreadable, changed or has no recorded hash, content stays absent and the reason says why; measureItem still never throws.
acceptanceChecks: measureItem returns content equal in length to totalChars for a whole-file kind and a line-range kind when the hash matches
measureItem returns no content and a reason for a changed, missing, unreadable and unhashed file, and never throws

tests.name: item-length.test.ts: measureItem returns the whole content of a whole-file and a line-range item and no content for a changed, missing, unreadable or unhashed file
